note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Both rooms are identical except the ONE supplied route state: A 'available, as supplied' (● sign, route drawn solid; the participant carries the sheet along the route) and B 'not checked, as supplied' (◆ sign, route drawn dashed — a neutral pending state; the sheet stays in the first tray while its dashed outline traces the same route). The bodies are abstract and fictional, of the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy); the route is ONLY the supplied sequence. No admissibility, time limit, leave, ground, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn; neither state is preferred. Brief fields: decisions, routes, outcomes (the two headers' states), scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable. OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a challenge would add legal content the comparison of a route's supplied state does not need.
